title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (September, 2025)
summary: Roundup of the September 2025 Business Central updates: the BC27 public preview, BC26 update 26.5 (CU05) with cloud and on-premises build numbers, BC25 CU11 (25.11) and BC24 CU17 (24.17). It also lists older versions as end of life and gives on-premises lifecycle dates under the Modern and Fixed policies.
key_points: BC27 (2025 release wave 2) is in public preview.
BC26 CU05 is version 26.5. The post gives the cloud and on-premises platform and application build numbers separately.
BC25 CU11 is update 25.11 and BC24 CU17 is update 24.17, each with application and platform builds.
Under the Modern policy, version 26.x is supported until Oct 13, 2026 and 25.x until Apr 4, 2026. Version 14.x under the Fixed policy ends Oct 14, 2025.
BC13 and BC15 through BC23 are marked end of life. BC14 is past mainstream support.

quotes.text: Business Central 2024 wave 2 (BC25): Manage environment updates more flexibly - Major update: 30(60) days -> 5-month and Optional minor updates
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes significant change to update policy reducing frequency and adding optionality
